title: Romantic Krabi, Koh Samui and Phuket
alt: Limestone cliffs and clear shallow water at Ao Nang beach in Krabi
transport: Private and shared transfers with speedboat and ferry crossings

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: One booked tour in six nights. Couples who want long mornings and no schedule usually pick this one.
expert.tip: Ask for a top floor room at Timber House so you get the cliffs from the balcony. On Samui, dinner at Fisherman's Village in Bophut is worth the short ride from Chaweng.

summary: Seven days for two across three Thai beaches. A night to land in Phuket, two under the cliffs of Ao Nang with the Krabi 4 Islands tour, two slow days on Koh Samui and a final Phuket night, with most of the time left free.
included: Included: 6 nights in 3 hotels with daily breakfast; Krabi 4 Islands speedboat tour with a lunch box; 14 airport, intercity and island transfers including the Samui ferry crossings both ways; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; temple and park entry fees; lunches and dinners other than the island tour lunch box; personal expenses.

1: Arrival at Phuket International Airport and private sedan transfer to Patong
Check in at Club Bamboo for one night and unwind
Optional: the Big Buddha on Nakkerd hill or the Phuket FantaSea show
2: Breakfast, check out and private sedan transfer by road to Krabi
Check in at Timber House in Ao Nang, under the limestone cliffs
Afternoon free along the beach road and on the sand
Optional: Tiger Cave temple, an elephant sanctuary or the night market
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to the Ao Nang pier
Speedboat transfer out to Koh Poda, Tup island and Chicken island
Snorkel the shallows, walk the sand bar and stop at Phra Nang beach
Lunch box on the boat, then a shared transfer back to your hotel
4: Breakfast, check out and shared transfer to the ferry terminal
Ferry transfer across to Koh Samui, then on to Chaweng
Check in at Montien House, set back from the beach among palms
Optional: Lad Koh viewpoint, Wat Sila Ngu or the Laem Sor pagoda
5: Breakfast, then a full day with nothing at all booked
Optional: the Big Buddha temple and the Hin Ta and Hin Yai rocks
Optional: a boat day out to the Ang Thong marine park
Fisherman's Village at Bophut is the nicest spot for dinner
6: Breakfast, check out and shared transfer to the Samui pier
Ferry transfer back across to Phuket and on to Patong
Check in for the last night and take the afternoon slowly
Optional: sunset at Promthep Cape, Wat Chalong or Karon viewpoint
7: Breakfast and an unhurried check out
Private sedan transfer to Phuket International Airport

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Club Bamboo in Patong, a short walk from the beach

program.name: One night to land and settle
program.description: A single night in Patong to shake off the flight, with the beach close enough to walk to before dinner.

activities.name: Phuket Big Buddha
activities.description: A white marble Buddha on Nakkerd hill with views over Chalong bay and Kata on a clear afternoon.

activities.name: Phuket FantaSea Show
activities.description: A large stage show on Thai myth with elephants, acrobatics and a buffet hall, out at Kamala beach.

stops.name: Krabi
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Timber House in Ao Nang, close to the beach road

program.name: Cliffs, islands and quiet evenings
program.description: Two nights in Ao Nang with a speedboat tour of the 4 Islands and evenings on the beach road.

activities.name: Krabi 4 Islands by Speedboat
activities.description: A speedboat day across Koh Poda, Tup island and Chicken island, with snorkelling, Phra Nang beach and a lunch box on board.

activities.name: Tiger Cave Temple
activities.description: Wat Tham Suea, with over twelve hundred steps up to a golden Buddha and a long view across the Krabi plain.

activities.name: Krabi Elephant Sanctuary
activities.description: A no riding sanctuary inland from Ao Nang where you feed and walk with rescued elephants alongside their keepers.

stops.name: Koh Samui
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Montien House among palms behind Chaweng beach

program.name: Two slow days on Samui
program.description: Nothing booked on the island. Chaweng beach on the doorstep, temples and viewpoints on the ring road when you feel like moving.

activities.name: Big Buddha Temple
activities.description: Wat Phra Yai on its small island, reached by causeway, with a golden seated Buddha looking out over the sea.

activities.name: Ang Thong Marine Park
activities.description: A boat day out to forty two islands with a hidden lagoon, snorkelling stops and a viewpoint climb on Koh Wua Talap.

activities.name: Fisherman's Village
activities.description: Old wooden shophouses at Bophut turned into cafes and bars, with a walking street market on Friday evenings.

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Back at Club Bamboo in Patong for the final night

program.name: A last Phuket night
program.description: Back across from Samui for a final evening, with the west coast viewpoints close by for a last sunset.

activities.name: Sunset at Promthep Cape
activities.description: The southern tip of Phuket, where the headland drops into the sea and the sunset draws a crowd every evening.

activities.name: Wat Chalong
activities.description: Phuket's largest temple, gilded and tiled, with a pagoda holding a splinter of bone relic on the top floor.

activities.name: Karon View Point
activities.description: The classic three bay lookout over Kata Noi, Kata and Karon on the road south from Patong.
